name: New Swarnima Scheme For Women
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: A subsidy amount of ₹2,00,000/- @ 5% per annum, for self-employment. (The remaining amount has to be self-owned by the beneficiary.)The beneficiary woman is not required to invest any amount of her own on the projects upto cost of Rs.2,00,000/-.
eligibility_rules: The applicant must be a FEMALE.The age of the applicant must be between 18 and 55 years. The applicant must be an EntrepreneurThe Total Annual Family Income of the Applicant must be Less than ₹ 3 Lakh per Annum
documents_required: CardDomicile CertificateCaste Certificate (for reserved category) Passport size Photograph of the applicant
how_to_apply: Mode: OfflineStep 1: Eligible applicant needs to visit nearest SCA office, apply on prescribed form for Swarnima Scheme for Women. You can find your nearest SCA office at this link - https://nsfdc.nic.in/channel-patrners/scasStep 2: Enter the necessary details in the application form and mention the needs and choice of vocation and training requirements, if any.Step 3: Submit your application form and the required documents to the same SCA office. After reviewing the application, the loan will be sanctioned by SCA.
